record.title_md: [Open Problem: m(C_t × C_s) for all t, s](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.07653)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem: m(C_t × C_s) for all t, s
dossier_meta.context_text: Proposition 3.2 establishes that $m(C_3 \times C_s) \leq 8$ for all $s > 36$ (since $K_3 = C_3$), answering a question raised in [6] about whether the connectivity code for large tori is strictly smaller than the trivial edge-connectivity bound $2^4 = 16$. The paper explicitly notes that the broader problem of determining $m(C_t \times C_s)$ for all $t$ and $s$ remains open.
